_comment: vLLM distributed workload. Set container.image, server_params.model, the socket-interface environment, and the models mount before running.

paths._comment: Host and container paths for model access, artifacts, and Hugging Face authentication.

container._comment: Container definition and static environment inherited by server, benchmark, and accuracy commands.
container.name: vllm_mistral-large-3_bf16_distributed_mi325x
container._comment_socket_interfaces: NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME should be the Linux netdev associated with the selected RNICs; GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME and TP_SOCKET_IFNAME generally use the frontend or control-plane NIC.
container._comment_gid_index: Set NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX to the RoCE/IB GID index available on every selected HCA and node; inspect show_gids or ibv_devinfo -v inside the container and choose the matching fabric entry.

runtime.name: docker

args._comment_bnxt_mount: Broadcom Thor2 (bnxt_re). Bind-mounts host /usr/local/lib/libbnxt_re-rdmav34.so read-only onto the container libibverbs provider path. Delete this entry when the nodes have no Thor2 library; docker run fails if the host path is missing.
args._comment_ionic_mounts: AMD Pensando Ionic / AINIC. Bind-mounts libionic.so, libionic.so.1, the versioned libionic.so.1.* soname, libibverbs/libionic-rdmav34.so, and /etc/libibverbs.d/ionic.driver. Replace that <changeme> volume with the versioned libionic.so.1.* file from readlink -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libionic.so.1, mounted at the same path, as _volumes_example shows. Delete these entries when the nodes have no Ionic stack; docker run fails if a host path is missing.

runtime._comment: Docker runtime and launch arguments applied on every participating node.

server_params._comment: Shared serving fields; engine_args holds every other vllm serve option.

benchmark_params._comment: vllm bench serve settings every cell runs with; client_args holds every other vllm bench serve option.

_comment_runs: Sweeps keys to run, in order; each runs with benchmark_params and its own overrides.
